#Tissue-specific  RNA-seq
Preparations

```{r}
setwd("")
wd<-("")
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
xlsxfile <- file.path(wd,"HumanTissueSamples205.xlsx")
sampleTable <- read_excel(xlsxfile)
View(sampleTable)
table(sampleTable$sampleID)
dfsamples<-data.frame(sampleTable)
str(dfsamples)
table(dfsamples$sampleID, dfsamples$tissue)
table(dfsamples$tissue)
table(dfsamples$subject)
```

```{r}
dim(sampleTable)
```

#RNA-Seq workflow
This workflow is based on quant files from Salmon

```{r}
library(tximeta)
library(DESeq2)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(GenomicFeatures)
```

Define the working directory where we have the data:

```{r}
dir<-("")
```

```{r}
samples <- data.frame(sampleTable)
samples
files <- file.path(dir, "tissue205quant",samples$sampleID, "quant.sf")
files
all(file.exists(files))
```

```{r}
coldata <- data.frame(files, names=samples$sampleID, samples)
```

```{r}
se <- tximeta(coldata)
```

```{r}
colData(se)
colnames(se)
```

```{r gtf}
gtffile <- ("gencode.v49.chr_patch_hapl_scaff.annotation.gtf")
```

```{r}
(txdb <- txdbmaker::makeTxDbFromGFF(gtffile, format="gtf"))
head(seqlevels(txdb))
```

```{r}
assayNames(se)
```

```{r}
rowRanges(se)
```

```{r}
seqinfo(se)
```

```{r exons}
se.exons <- addExons(se)
rowRanges(se.exons)[[1]]
```

```{r}
save(se,file = "SEtissuesRNAseqTX.RData")
```

## Gene-level summarisation

```{r gene level}
gse <- summarizeToGene(se)
rowRanges(gse)
```

```{r}
dim(se)
dim(gse)
```

## DESeq2

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
gse$tissue
gse$subject
gse$tissue <- factor(gse$tissue)
gse$subject <- factor(gse$subject)
gse$tissue
gse$subject
colData(gse)
```
Tissues as factors

```{r}
gse$adipose <- factor(gse$adipose)
gse$adrenal  <- factor(gse$adrenal)
gse$appendix <- factor(gse$appendix)
gse$bladder <- factor(gse$bladder)
gse$bonemarrow <- factor(gse$bonemarrow)
gse$cerebralcortex <- factor(gse$cerebralcortex)
gse$colon <- factor(gse$colon)
gse$duodenum <- factor(gse$duodenum)
gse$endometrium <- factor(gse$endometrium)
gse$esophagus <- factor(gse$esophagus)
gse$fallopiantube <- factor(gse$fallopiantube)
gse$gallbladder <- factor(gse$gallbladder)
gse$heart <- factor(gse$heart)
gse$kidney <- factor(gse$kidney)
gse$liver <- factor(gse$liver)
gse$lung <- factor(gse$lung)
gse$lymphnode <- factor(gse$lymphnode)
gse$ovary <- factor(gse$ovary)
gse$pancreas <- factor(gse$pancreas)
gse$placenta <- factor(gse$placenta)
gse$prostate <- factor(gse$prostate)
gse$rectum <- factor(gse$rectum)
gse$salivarygland <- factor(gse$salivarygland)
gse$skeletalmuscle <- factor(gse$skeletalmuscle)
gse$skin <- factor(gse$skin)
gse$smallintestine <- factor(se$smallintestine)
gse$smoothmuscle <- factor(gse$smoothmuscle)
gse$spleen <- factor(gse$spleen)
gse$stomach <- factor(se$stomach)
gse$testis <- factor(gse$testis)
gse$thyroid <- factor(gse$thyroid)
gse$tonsil <- factor(gse$tonsil)
```

```{r}
save(gse, file="gSEtissuesRNAseqGE.RData")
```
```{r}
load("gSEtissuesRNAseqGE.RData")
```

## Prepare Ensembl annotation for the res tables.

```{r}
#BiocManager::install("biomaRt")
library(biomaRt)
```

```{r}
listMarts()
ensembl_hs_mart <- useMart(biomart="ensembl", dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl") 
ensembl_df <- getBM(attributes=c("ensembl_gene_id","description","ensembl_transcript_id","hgnc_symbol", "entrezgene_trans_name","chromosome_name", "band", "entrezgene_id", "external_transcript_name"), mart=ensembl_hs_mart)
```

## Gene-level analysis

```{r tissue}
gdds <- DESeqDataSet(gse, design = ~ tissue)
```

```{r}
colData(gse)
colnames(colData(gse))
```

```{r adjust rownames}
rownames(res)
row.names(res)[1:10]
res$GENE<-row.names(res)
rownames(res)<- gsub("\\..*", "", res$GENE)
rownames(res)[1:10]
resOrdered <- res[order(res$padj),]
head(resOrdered)
```

```{r}
my_genes = row.names(resOrdered)
my_genes_ann = ensembl_df[match(my_genes, ensembl_df$ensembl_gene_id),]
colnames(my_genes_ann)
my_genes_ann
```

```{r}
res2 <- cbind(resOrdered, my_genes_ann[match(rownames(resOrdered), my_genes_ann$ensembl_gene_id), ,drop=FALSE])
resOrdered <- res2[order(res2$padj),]
resSig <- subset(resOrdered, padj < 0.05)
head(resSig)
```

```{r}
write.csv(as.data.frame(resSig), file="resSigADIPOSEFDR005.csv")
```

Normalised counts with Gene ID

```{r res2}
gdds2 <- gdds
rowData(gdds2) <- cbind(rowData(gdds), my_genes_ann[match(rowData(gdds)$gene_id, my_genes_ann$ensembl_gene_id), ,drop=FALSE])
rownames(gdds2)[1:4]
rownames(gdds2)<-rowData(gdds2)$hgnc_symbol
rownames(gdds2)[1:4]
resOrdered <- res2[order(res2$padj),]
resSig <- subset(resOrdered, padj < 0.05)
write.csv(as.data.frame(resSig), file="Tissue250deseq2ensembl.csv")
write.csv(as.data.frame(resOrdered), file="Tissue250deseq2ensemblresOrdered.csv")
```

```{r}
save(gdds2, file="gDDS2_SEtissuesRNAseqGE.RData")
```

```{r}
normcodata<-counts(gdds2, normalized=T)
write.table(as.data.frame(normcodata), file="NormCountdata_250TissuesGeneId.txt", sep="\t")
```
